name: Zombie Survivor
detailed_description:
SURVIVE THE ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE

The undead have overrun the world, and you're humanity's last hope. Armed with an arsenal of weapons and powerful abilities, fight through endless waves of zombies in this intense bullet-hell survival experience.

DYNAMIC WEAPON SYSTEM

  • 4 Weapon Types: Master the Machine Gun, Rifle, Shotgun, and Revolver, each with unique firing patterns and tactical advantages

  • Advanced Ammo Management: Reload strategically and manage your ammunition reserves across different weapon types

  • Weapon Progression: Unlock and purchase new weapons using coins earned in battle

  • Manual & Auto Fire Modes: Switch between precision shooting and rapid-fire combat

POWERFUL ABILITIES & UPGRADES

  • Combat Abilities: Deploy devastating attacks including Sniper shots, Bomber explosions, Laser attacks, and Grenade throwing

  • Tactical Support: Call in AI-controlled Soldier allies and Combat Drones to fight alongside you

  • Passive Upgrades: Enhance your Health, Movement Speed, and Damage through the progression system

  • Ability Evolution: Level up your abilities to unlock enhanced damage, reduced cooldowns, and increased effectiveness

CHALLENGING ENEMY VARIETY

  • Diverse Zombie Types: Face Urban Zombies, Zombie Police, Zombie Soldiers, and terrifying Mutants

  • Adaptive AI: Enemies become more aggressive and numerous as you survive longer

  • Wave-Based Spawning: Experience carefully balanced enemy deployment that scales with your performance

SURVIVAL MECHANICS

  • Experience System: Gain XP by eliminating enemies and level up to unlock new abilities

  • Resource Management: Collect coins and supplies from defeated enemies and air drops

  • Air Drop Support: Receive emergency supply drops containing valuable resources and equipment

  • Health Management: Monitor your health carefully as damage accumulates over time

PROGRESSION & STRATEGY

  • Character Development: Choose from multiple upgrade paths to customize your playstyle

  • Strategic Decisions: Balance offensive abilities with defensive upgrades and support units

  • Respec Options: Use re-roll mechanics to adapt your build as situations change

  • Performance Tracking: Monitor your survival time, enemies eliminated, and other statistics

GAME FEATURES

  • Endless Gameplay: Survive as long as possible against increasingly difficult waves

  • Smooth Controls: Responsive movement and shooting mechanics optimized for fast-paced action

  • Visual Feedback: Dynamic damage indicators, blood effects, and particle systems enhance the combat experience

  • Pause System: Take strategic breaks to plan your next moves

  • Store System: Purchase new weapons and equipment between runs

TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS

  • Built with Godot Engine for smooth performance

  • Pixel-perfect rendering for crisp visuals

  • Comprehensive controller support alongside keyboard and mouse

  • Optimized enemy deployment system prevents performance drops

  • Modular ability system allows for complex combinations and strategies

Whether you prefer run-and-gun tactics or strategic positioning, Survivor offers multiple paths to victory. Master the art of zombie elimination, manage your resources wisely, and see how long you can survive in this unforgiving world.

How long can YOU survive?
